      <div data-fluid-engine="true"><style></style><div class="fluid-engine fe-6a3c3d71c7129545bc86772b"><div class="fe-block fe-block-b616e0833009818976e2"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block sqs-background-enabled" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/c1bfc41a-46c9-470b-b2eb-d4ecdb81ee26_984/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="b616e0833009818976e2" id="block-b616e0833009818976e2"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>If your idea of a perfect day is loading up your gear and heading out on an unforgettable mission, this is your camp.</strong></p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Our Adventure Foiling Camp in La Ventana, Baja Mexico is designed for intermediate and advanced riders who want to experience the endless possibilities that the Sea of Cortez has to offer. Every day brings a new destination, new conditions, and another story to tell over happy hour.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Forget the stress of planning. We take care of everything so you can focus on riding and enjoying your vacation.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Stay in your own private bedroom and bathroom in a beautiful villa with a pool and hot tub. Start each day with yoga and a healthy breakfast prepared by your private chef before heading out for another day of adventure with your camp host.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Throughout the week, we’ll embark on a variety of epic missions. Conditions permitting, we may cross to the deserted island of Cerralvo for lunch and cold beers before returning to the Baja mainland, circumnavigate the island, foil to the lighthouse and back, or ride upwind to a beach club for a snack before making our way back to Playa Central.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The adventure doesn’t stop when the wind takes a break. Included in the week is an unforgettable ocean safari excursion where we’ll search for whales and dolphins and snorkel with playful sea lions in the crystal-clear waters of the Sea of Cortez.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">No two weeks are exactly alike, and every camp is shaped by the wind, swell, and spirit of adventure.</p><h4 style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">This is more than a camp: it’s a week of unforgettable experiences with a group of like-minded riders.</h4></div>

          <p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Absolutely. Bring a friend to share your room and the experience with! Reserve your spots ASAP, then <a href="/contact">contact us</a> to arrange and receive a special 5% discount.</p><p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Non-riding guests are welcome and can enjoy all accommodations, meals, transportation, and activities for $1,899.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
        <div data-sqsp-accordion-block-divider class="accordion-divider" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    </li>
    <li class="accordion-item" >
      <h4
        class="
          accordion-item__title-wrapper
        "
        data-sqsp-accordion-block-item-title
      >
        <button
          id="button-c897f30c9e85f919c240-2"
          class="accordion-item__click-target"
          aria-expanded="false"
          aria-controls="dropdown-c897f30c9e85f919c240-2"
        >
          <span class="accordion-item__title">Which airport should I fly into?</span>
          <div class="accordion-icon-container" aria-hidden="true">
              <div class="plus">
                <div class="plus__horizontal-line"></div>
                <div class="plus__vertical-line"></div>
              </div>
          </div>
        </button>
      </h4>
      <div
        class="accordion-item__dropdown"
        id="dropdown-c897f30c9e85f919c240-2"
        role="region"
        aria-labelledby="button-c897f30c9e85f919c240-2"
      >
        <div
          class="
            accordion-item__description
          "
          data-sqsp-accordion-block-item-description
        >
          <p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The only planning you have to do is book your flight - all of the other details and logistics are included in your camp. We pick you up at the airport and take care of all local transportation from the moment you land. Most guests fly into SJD (Los Cabos International Airport), which is about a two-hour drive from La Ventana in our shuttle. You can also look at flights into LAP (La Paz International Airport), just 45 minutes away, which has become increasingly popular thanks to convenient and affordable flights from Tijuana.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
        <div data-sqsp-accordion-block-divider class="accordion-divider" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    </li>
    <li class="accordion-item" >

          <p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">7:00 AM: Wake up and enjoy coffee - or sleep in.</p><p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">8:00 AM: Morning yoga at the villa.</p><p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">9:00 AM: Healthy breakfast prepared by your private chef.</p><p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">11:00 AM: Launch into the day’s adventure. Depending on conditions, we may cross to Cerralvo Island, head for the lighthouse, ride upwind to a beach club, or embark on another unforgettable foiling mission.</p><p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">1:30 PM: Enjoy lunch along the way. Some days we’ll stop for tacos or ceviche, other days we’ll enjoy a picnic with cold beers on the deserted beaches of Cerralvo Island.</p><p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Afternoon: Continue chasing swell and glides, explore new routes, and maximize time on the water. On lighter days, we may head out on our ocean safari excursion to see whales, dolphins, and snorkel with sea lions.</p><p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">5:00 PM: Back at the villa, shower off, relax by the pool, and gather for happy hour while sharing stories from the day’s adventure.</p><p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">6:30 PM: Head into town for dinner together and experience the vibrant food scene that has made La Ventana.</p><p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Evening: Enjoy sunset cocktails, live music, stargazing, or unwind in the hot tub while planning tomorrow’s mission.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
        <div data-sqsp-accordion-block-divider class="accordion-divider" aria-hidden="true"></div>
